program: SkyraSoft HBOS Retail Platform & Workforce Integrity Program

human_actor_identity_principle.chain_of_identity: User -> Business membership -> Branch membership(s) -> Role -> Canonical Permissions
human_actor_identity_principle.attribution_guarantee: Every material operation records immutable human causer identification

token_properties.storage: Hashed via Hash::make() in database (never stored in plaintext)
token_properties.single_use: Invalidated immediately upon successful password establishment (token set to null)
token_properties.deactivation_invalidation: Token invalidated immediately if user record is deactivated or deleted

capabilities_exposed: List employees with active business and branch scoping
Create employee with role, branches, and invitation token generation
Display copyable single-use invitation link modal

privilege_escalation_guards.salesperson_restrictions: Cannot create users, cannot assign roles, cannot modify branches
privilege_escalation_guards.manager_restrictions: Cannot create or promote to Business Owner, cannot assign platform roles
privilege_escalation_guards.owner_protection: Only authenticated Business Owner can grant administrative or owner roles

deactivation_security.login_policy: Login rejected with HTTP 403 ('Your account is inactive')
deactivation_security.token_policy: Any existing Sanctum bearer token rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthenticated
deactivation_security.historical_integrity: Preserved. Historical sales, movements, payments, and activity logs remain attributed to user
